title: A story appears on a website without permission

options.text: Post the website owner's private details online.

options.text: Assume the allegation is proven and take public action immediately.
options.feedback: Avoid turning “A story appears on a website without permission” into a public confrontation. Threats, doxxing or declaring someone guilty can cause harm and undermine a legitimate concern. Preserve facts and use a responsible reporting channel instead.

options.text: Share the material widely and ask strangers to decide what happened.
options.feedback: Spreading the material can increase its reach and may expose private information. In “A story appears on a website without permission”, share only what is necessary with the relevant platform or reporting team, not with an uncontrolled audience.

lesson: A public webpage is evidence of availability, not proof that permission was absent. Example: save the page URL, date, screenshots and the name of the copied story. If infringement is suspected, email the details to STOP@copyright.gov.ng.
